question.text: Custodian details in the SEBI application must include:

answer.text: Name, address, SEBI registration number, date of appointment

explanation.text: The Logic: All four fields are required in the registration application. The Trap: Incomplete details will be flagged by SEBI. Cross-Exam Context: Same in III-C, IX. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Maintain a tracker for custodian appointment changes and notify SEBI promptly.
